entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-15
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Behavior of a user-defined conditional logical operator depends on order of `true`/`false` operator declarations #78602
  • RS0016 - value types - not all fixes can be applied #78601
  • Unexpected output from Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.SyntaxTree.ToString() after calling GetCompilationUnitRoot() #78593
  • Can't build after updating to Visual Studio 2022 17.14.0 and dotnet sdk 9.0.300 #78592
  • [Bug] Error loading project for misc file in VSCode #78591
  • Miscellaneous files not shown as misc #78590
  • FileBasedProgramsProjectSystem is creating bin and obj directories in the user's folder if they open a random .cs that's not a file-based program #78589
  • RS1024 reported for sources in Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Extensions package #78583

Closed

  • OverrideCompletionProvider error in Razor files #78119
  • `InvalidOperationException` in `SemanticTokensHelpers` when applying embedded classification on verbatim string #74809
    17.13
  • Compiler crash: generic `extension` block with `async` method #78487
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10613.86 #78586
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-10614.55 #78585

PullRequests

Created

  • Ensure return local is the correct type for runtime async #78603
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Merge 'main' into 'extensions' #78600
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Ensure we pass unique binlog paths to each BuildHost #78599
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Add `Enum.IsDefined` refactoring #78597
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • initial work to allow copilot to add imports when making recomendations. #78595
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Support consumption of binary extension operators #78594
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Give .NET Framework build task in sdk different identity #78584
    Area-Compilers

Merged

  • More improvements to source packages #78587
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Rename LSP messages for VisualStudio.Extensibility integration #78598
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Add a reference to the tracking bug for a workaround #78582
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Revert "Update XAML EA to use DocumentUri instead of System.Uri (#78555)" #78596
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Fix embedded language classification inside multi-line string #78588
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Remove localized strings from Collections source package #78576
    Area-IDE, Next

Updated

  • Move NullAsynchronousOperationListenerProvider to source package #77187
    Area-Infrastructure, untriaged, VSCode
  • Reduce duplicated FileUtilities.GetFileTimeStamp calls #78321
    Area-IDE, untriaged
  • Track used assemblies of data section string literals #78552
    Area-Compilers, Feature - String Literals in Data Section as UTF8
